rename.reason: Shadows the Python standard-library ast module (breaks on Python >= 3.14); importers are rewritten to 'from lite_ast import'.

flatbuffers.note: Only configured with -DLITE_UPDATE_FBS_HEAD=ON. The tiny publish uses the pre-generated headers in third-party/flatbuffers/pre-build of the pinned Paddle Lite commit; the build fails if any ExternalProject download stamp appears.

build.reproducibility: expectedSha256 pins the stripped runtime and headers built in registry.gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroidserver:buildserver-trixie at /home/vagrant/build/com.fpink.capture (F-Droid's build path) with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set to the pinned Paddle Lite commit time; null means not pinned yet. -PpaddleRuntimeBuiltFromSource fails on a mismatch unless -PallowUnpinnedPaddleRuntime is set.
